hypothesis: Fixed causal bar, regime, side, and breakout-relation features modeled by Ridge or shallow LightGBM may rank exact ETH precompression-pullback entries well enough to improve selection after a 13-bps modeled round trip.
decision: Reject the fixed Ridge and shallow LightGBM entry-selection family. Both candidates had zero positive-rank-IC development folds, negative median tail spreads, negative pooled development top-quintile economics, and unstable side/relation leadership. Keep the current ETH route unchanged and keep these models out of routing, filtering, sizing, entry, and exit decisions. Preserve route-side and breakout-relation telemetry. A future ML trial must be a separately registered mechanism with materially different venue-native event/orderbook features and exact after-cost labels; do not rescue this trial by post-hoc inversion, subgroup selection, or a hyperparameter sweep.
falsifier: This rejection is invalidated by changed evidence bytes, incorrect route or side identity, timestamp leakage, failure of the outcome-time purge, an incorrect 13-bps modeled-cost contract, or replay mismatch with the exact ETH strategy. Reconsider the broader ML direction only if a separately predeclared route-side model produces stable positive development rank and after-cost tail economics across non-adjacent folds, stays positive without its largest winner, and repeats prospectively. A favorable final-period subgroup selected after inspection does not falsify this fixed-family decision.
limitations: The exact ETH entry and lifecycle shape was selected before this model trial through multiple prior experiments.
The opened final 60-day block was previously inspected and is descriptive rather than sealed confirmation.
Bar-derived features cannot reproduce private IOC latency, queue position, or the full event-level orderbook path.
Serial market regimes remain dependent even though the replayed lifecycles do not overlap.
Side/relation and top-quintile cells have smaller effective samples and were inspected only for attribution, not promotion.
Earlier immutable artifacts remain preserved as schema-correction evidence and are not the authoritative decision artifact.
This revision cannot gate, rank, route, size, enter, close, restart, or promote a live strategy.
